edges.sentence: On 2026-10-02, Reuters reported “Nonfarm payrolls likely increased by 90,000 last month”; on the same day, Reuters reported “Nonfarm payrolls likely increased by 90,000 last month after surging by 162,000 in August, a Reuters survey of economists predicted.”.

On 2026-10-02, Bureau of Labor Statistics reported “monthly gain of 45,000 over the prior 12 months”; on the same day, Bureau of Labor Statistics reported “Total nonfarm payroll employment changed little in September (+29,000), following an average monthly gain of 45,000 over the prior 12 months.”.

On 2026-10-02, Bureau of Labor Statistics reported “Total nonfarm payroll employment changed little in September (+29,000), following an average”; on the same day, Bureau of Labor Statistics reported “Total nonfarm payroll employment changed little in September (+29,000), following an average monthly gain of 45,000 over the prior 12 months.”.

On 2026-10-02, Bureau of Labor Statistics reported “employment in July and August combined is 60,000 lower than previously reported”; on the same day, Bureau of Labor Statistics reported “With these revisions, employment in July and August combined is 60,000 lower than previously reported.”.

On 2026-10-02, CNBC reported “Economists surveyed by Dow Jones had been looking for job growth of 84,000”; on the same day, CNBC reported “Economists surveyed by Dow Jones had been looking for job growth of 84,000 and an unemployment rate of 4.1%.”.

On 2026-10-02, Bureau of Labor Statistics reported “Both the unemployment rate, at 4.2 percent, and the number of unemployed people, at 7.1 million,”; on the same day, Bureau of Labor Statistics reported “Both the unemployment rate, at 4.2 percent, and the number of unemployed people, at 7.1 million, changed little in September.”.

On 2026-10-02, Bureau of Labor Statistics reported “by 3.0 percent. In September, average hourly earnings of private-sector production and”; on the same day, Bureau of Labor Statistics reported “Over the past 12 months, average hourly earnings have increased by 3.0 percent.”.
